releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.9 — Automatic PC Restart Prompts & Kernel Synchronization:
- Automatic Restart Prompts: Whenever an action requires a PC restart (such as turning on HAGS for RTX 4060 Optical Flow FrameGen or resetting the TCP/IP network stack), the app now provides a 1-click confirmation dialog to restart your PC immediately or defer until later.
- Zero-Jitter Network Engine: Restored standard gaming QoS to fix packet jitter and ping spikes in multiplayer games.
- OmniMotion AI Native: In-house 2X/3X frame generation engine with dynamic button lighting.
